verdict.rationale: Puzzle's docs show a built-in invoice editor for creating branded invoices with a live preview, and they mention emails sent from Puzzle, so it covers the create-and-send core. Nothing in the evidence documents online payment options on invoices or tracking of when invoices are viewed or paid. missing for 10: online payment options on invoices, viewed/paid status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration of sending

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Puzzle's invoice editor lets you build a professional, branded invoice and see exactly how it will look as you go!
applies everywhere your invoice appears — the live preview, downloaded PDFs, and emails sent from Puzzle.
a live preview on the right that updates as you type — so you always know what your customer will see.
